text:
jamie: Quick find — our JS SDK examples use `modelName` while Python and REST use `model`. That's probably going to confuse migration scripts.
omar: Ouch. Which files?
jamie: Found in /docs/reference/sdk/js/examples and one landing page in /docs/guides/migration. Example:```js
client.generate({ modelName: 'redwood/guanaco-7b-q4', prompt: '...' })
``` vs elsewhere we show `model: 'redwood/guanaco-7b-q4'`.
frank: We should standardize on `model` across SDKs. Less surface area and matches REST. Also add a tiny glossary note about family vs variant vs profile.
mira: Agreed. I'll make a one-line glossary blurb and a migration snippet for the JS guide. Suggest wording: "Use `model` as the parameter; include variant suffix in the model identifier (e.g., `redwood/guanaco-7b-q4`)."
ojames: (typo, ignore)
omar: Also saw inconsistent spelling: some pages say "quantisation" (UK) and others "quantization" (US). We should pick one (prefer US for consistency with SDKs).
frank: Yes, use "quantization" across docs. Add a docs-style checklist item: preferred spellings.
docs-ci: Link/lint check running on branch docs/sdk-model-param-cleanup-1802. Found: 1 broken link in /docs/guides/migration.md -> https://old.example.com/migrate (404) and 1 spelling mismatch (quantisation vs quantization).
mira: I'll replace the broken link with `/docs/guides/migration#migrating-params` and normalize spelling. Also will soft-tone the migration text: replace "you must" -> "we recommend" unless it's a breaking API removal.
jamie: Can someone handle the JS snippet change? Need to change `modelName` -> `model` and add a small inline comment: `// use model param; include variant in value`
omar: I can open the JS SDK PR and update examples. I'll also add a changelog bullet: "SDK: standardized model param name (model) across languages; see migration guide."
frank: Add a one-liner in the glossary example section: `Example: model='redwood/guanaco-7b-q4'` and cross-ref to SDK examples.
mira: Will push glossary + migration edits and ping @omar and @jamie for quick review.
docs-ci: CI will re-run link/spelling checks after the PRs merge.
jamie: Thanks — small fix but will save users time. Closing after merges. :white_check_mark:
